Commentary.Commentary: Virat Kohli smashed a double ton whereas Ajinkya Rahane missed that by a whisker. Even Rohit Sharma came to the party as he hit a quickfire fifty and took India past the 550-run mark. The Kiwi bowlers could have bowled well but the Indian batsmen were extremely good, especially Rahane and Kohli. Boult and Patel snared two wickets each while Santner got one. Let's see how the Kiwis reply now. First their aim would be to bat till stumps without any wicket. Stay tuned for New Zealand's innings.

Brilliant performance by India yet again! They've posted a strong total on the board and have given New Zealand 9 overs to bat on. They were in some trouble when the Kiwis reduced them to 100/3 but then Virat Kohli and Ajinkya Rahane shared an epic partnership. The duo added 365 runs for the fourth wicket and took India to a very dominant position.

Jeetan Patel and Mitchell Santner bowled intelligently and varied their pace nicely. They extracted ample amount of assistance from the pitch and made Kohli and Rahane work hard for every run. Henry and Boult also sprinted in and gave it their all. However, the duo have seen the session through and would like to add as much as possible when they come back to bat in the final session. On the other hand, the Black Caps would like to strike early and make a dent. Stay tuned as the play will resume in a short while.

It was quite an interesting session with the pitch starting to play tricks in the first day itself. India have done well to score 73 runs in 30 overs for the loss of only one wicket. The Kiwis began the session on a bright note as Santner bamboozled Pujara with a beauty and castled his stumps. After that, Kohli and Rahane have fought bravely in the middle with the former getting a bit lucky at times.

Pujara and Kohli have started to build up the innings again and would be eager to carry on. On the other hand, New Zealand would look to break the partnership and make it difficult for the home side. Join us for the post-lunch session in a short while.

It was an even session and we can say that both sides have shared it. 26 overs were bowled and 75 runs were scored for the loss of two wickets. Williamson introduced Jeetan Patel early on and it was an intelligent bit of captaincy. It worked as Patel struck in his first over and sent Vijay back to the hut.

New Zealand captain, Kane Williamson feels that the wicket is a bit tacky and may provide some support to the bowlers. Says that they need to put India under pressure. (On his comeback) Says that he is feeling well now and ready to go. (On team changes) Mentions Jimmy Neesham comes in for Neil Wagner and he himself comes in for Henry Nicholls.

India captain, Virat Kohli says that they would like to bat first and feels it will play well for the first two days and they would look to put up a big score. (On momentum) Says that they would look to carry on with it as there is a long home series ahead. (On the new venue) Says that it is a historic day for Indore as it is hosting its first Test match. Feels that it is a sporting wicket, bowlers would get help if they bowl well and batsmen would also have scoring opportunities on this pitch. (On team changes) Mentions that Bhuvneshwar Kumar is out with a niggle and Umesh Yadav comes in his place. Shikhar Dhawan is out with an injury and Gautam Gambhir replaces him.
INDIA WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT!

Hello and a warm welcome for the final Test match between India and New Zealand in Indore. With the series already in their kitty, India would look to come out with the intention of a whitewash. The Kiwis will look to come out and give their best shot to salvage some pride. It promises to be an exciting contest between bat and ball. Should be a thrilling game if New Zealand give their best.
